small_guidance:
- The gather formulation wastes work: with stride=2, only 1/4 of (kh,kw) combinations per output position are valid (the parity check `ih_num % STRIDE == 0` masks 75% of the IC loop). Restructure so each output (oh,ow) computes only the single (kh,kw) pair matching its parity — split into 4 sub-kernels or compute kh_start = (oh+PAD) % STRIDE, kw_start similarly, and only iterate kh in {kh_start} (one value), removing the 4× redundant IC GEMM passes.
- Add autotune configs with larger BLOCK_SP (256, 512) and try BLOCK_IC=64 with num_stages=4; current IC=64 means the inner loop only runs 1-2 iterations so software pipelining benefits are minimal — instead make BLOCK_IC=IC=64 a single pass and increase BLOCK_OC to 128.
- Swap the dot orientation / layout so x_tile is loaded as [BLOCK_SP, BLOCK_IC] contiguous along IC — currently x_addrs has IC as the outer (strided by IH*IW) dimension, causing strided loads; transpose to load IC contiguously along the channel axis (or transpose weight pre-pass) for better coalescing.
large_guidance:
- Rewrite as a per-parity direct kernel: split the output into 4 sub-grids by (oh%2, ow%2). For each parity, the (kh,kw) is uniquely determined, so the kernel becomes a pure GEMM of shape (OC, IH*IW) = W[ic,oc,kh_p,kw_p] @ X[n,ic,:,:] — a clean batched matmul with no masking, no parity checks, ~4× less arithmetic than the current scatter/gather. Launch as one persistent kernel per parity or fuse all 4 with a parity index in program_id.
- Alternative: implicit-im2col GEMM where K = IC*KH*KW and M=OC, N=N*OH*OW. Pre-permute weight to [OC, IC*KH*KW] once at init. Use BLOCK_M=64, BLOCK_N=128, BLOCK_K=32 with proper masking on the input gather. This gives a single dense GEMM per program with tensor-core utilization, and the parity-zero columns naturally mask out as zeros in the gather.
- Use channels_last (NHWC) memory layout for both input and output so the IC/OC axis is contiguous; this makes the GEMM-K reduction stride-1 and the bias/clamp/scale epilogue free. Keep the full clamp→scale→clamp→divide epilogue fused at the end (already done).
